name: Pull request reviewer
description: Reviews a diff, decides approve vs request-changes by rule, and formats the review for posting.

config.system_prompt: You are a senior engineer reviewing a pull request. Be specific: cite line content, not line numbers. Never invent code that is not in the diff.

config.prompt:
Turn these findings into a short, friendly approval comment for GitHub (markdown, nits as a checklist):
{{findings}}

Turn these findings into a GitHub review requesting changes (markdown). Lead with blockers, keep the tone kind and direct:
{{findings}}
